title: 🏗️ Project Foundation & Authentication Setup
description: Essential project setup including server initialization, database connection, user authentication, and login/register functionality. This MUST be completed before any feature development.
acceptance_criteria: Server starts successfully on configured port
Database connection is established and tested
JWT authentication middleware validates tokens correctly
Login and Register pages are accessible and functional
Test framework is configured and sample tests pass

sub_tasks.title: Initialize project with package.json and configuration files
sub_tasks.description: Create package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, and install essential dependencies
sub_tasks.notes: Created root package.json, server/client package.json files with all dependencies, TypeScript configurations, and environment template

sub_tasks.title: Create express server entry point and middleware
sub_tasks.description: Set up Express/NestJS/Fastify server, body parser, CORS, error handling middleware
sub_tasks.notes: Created Express app with Helmet security, CORS, body parsing, health check endpoint, error handling middleware, and logger utility

sub_tasks.title: Set up postgresql database connection pool (Node.js/TypeScript)
sub_tasks.description: Configure database connection using .env file parameters with pg pool
sub_tasks.notes: Created PostgreSQL connection pool with environment variables, graceful shutdown handlers, and connection test utility

sub_tasks.title: Implement User model and authentication system
sub_tasks.description: Create User model, password hashing, JWT utilities, AuthService, and auth routes
sub_tasks.notes: Created complete authentication system with User model, bcrypt password hashing (12 rounds), JWT token generation/verification, AuthService with register/login/getUserById, auth middleware for protected routes, and Zod validation schemas

sub_tasks.title: Create react app structure and routing
sub_tasks.description: Set up React/Vue/Angular app, routing, folder structure, base components
sub_tasks.notes: Created React 18 app with Vite, React Router v6, Tailwind CSS styling, API client with interceptors, AuthContext for state management, and protected route component

sub_tasks.title: Create Login and Register pages with form validation
sub_tasks.description: Build login/register UI, form validation, API integration, auth state management
sub_tasks.notes: Created Login and Register pages with form validation, error handling, loading states, and Tailwind CSS styling. Dashboard page serves as landing page after authentication.

sub_tasks.title: Configure testing framework and utilities
sub_tasks.description: Set up Jest/Vitest, testing library, test utilities, mocks, and sample tests
sub_tasks.notes: Created Jest configurations for both server (Node environment) and client (jsdom environment) with TypeScript support, coverage reporting, and proper module mapping

sub_tasks.title: 🚨 CRITICAL: Validate Node.js/TypeScript Server Setup
sub_tasks.description: Validate that all components work together - dependencies install, code compiles, server starts, database connects, and endpoints respond correctly
sub_tasks.notes: All code files have been created. Next step: User needs to run npm install, set up .env file, ensure PostgreSQL is running, run database migration, and test the server startup.
